verdict.rationale: First-party docs reference a user-controlled 'Model Improvement' setting in privacy settings. They describe training on chats or coding sessions as something that happens only 'when you allow us' to use them. Incognito chats are never used to improve Claude, and Google Workspace connector data is never used for training. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to turn the Model Improvement toggle off and what its default state is, clarity on whether opting out applies retroactively to past data, independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.
